guardReason: Posts the weekly metrics comment with gh unless --dry-run; meant to run only from ci-metrics.yml.
description: Posts one comment a week to the 'Weekly CI metrics' issue: main CI's time to a Required CI answer and job minutes per run by event, merge-queue runs per merged pull request, main pushes that reused the queue's result, peak concurrency, failure rates and flaky jobs, each compared with the previous week.
